description: Copy-paste SDK setup code for a platform, identical to the dashboard setup guide: install, init and extra steps with the app ID and API URL filled in. Write the code into the user’s project as given. Required scope: users:read.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

lang.description: Language of the comments inside the code (default en).

platform.description: SDK platform; use `sdk_platforms` from get_setup_status for the app’s own selection.

variant.description: Code tab, e.g. kotlin|java (android), spm|cocoapods (ios), script|npm|package (react, nextjs, vue, angular). Defaults to the first tab.

name: get_sdk_snippet
title: SDK setup code
